senses.sense_definition: iemand gevangen houden om eisen af te dwingen

examples.text: De overvallers <w>gijzelden</w> de aanwezige klanten in de bank.

target_lang_translations.en: The robbers <w>took the customers present in the bank hostage</w>.

examples.text: De politie probeerde te voorkomen dat de daders de mensen zouden <w>gijzelen</w>.

target_lang_translations.en: The police tried to prevent the perpetrators from <w>taking the people hostage</w>.

target_lang_definitions.en: To hold someone captive in order to force the fulfillment of demands.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: To seize and hold a person as security for demands.
To keep someone in captivity to enforce demands.
